With a 0.4% stop on TQQQ hourly, a large share of trades would stop out inside the entry hour; every H404700 number (sweep trials #17/#48, F404702 walk-forward) is on the non-live-faithful N+2 path.

claim: The result looks like leveraged long beta in a TQQQ uptrend, not dip-buying: RSI(7)<80 is not an oversold filter, so entries fire on most bars where the MACD histogram ticks up; a +1.93%/-0.47% payoff needs only a 19.6% win rate, which trending exposure supplies. Returns are concentrated: dropping the best 5% of days removes 52% of train and 63% of holdout summed return. Must be benchmarked against exposure-matched TQQQ buy&hold over the same window before being called an edge.
